poll.question: The panther's resting ten feet from Mutu. Wesley's breathing finally slowed. Does Chills trust this peace enough to sleep—or stay awake, holding the line until dawn?

options.label: Sleep in shifts
options.desc: Mutu held the dark still. That's enough. Rest now.

options.label: One stays awake
options.desc: Vigilance is the boundary. Someone has to hold it through the night.

in_play.label: Move closer
in_play.desc: Hold each other steady. Their bond is shelter.
